martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, cycling looks great today, especially between 8 and 10 when it's a pleasant 20°C with moderate winds. You might want to drag Britt along for a ride before it gets too warm. The afternoon isn't ideal with gusts picking up, so make the most of the morning.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, cycling conditions are great today, especially between 08:00–10:00 when it's a comfortable 20°C. Moderate gusts might pick up later, so make the most of the morning. If Martha's free, drag her along for a ride, and you can both unwind with a drink on the terrace afterwards.
